title_en: Wonders of Chinese Engineering (1/20): The Three Gorges Dam
note_en: The 把 construction moves the object in front of the verb when the sentence is about what is done to it: 能把大船像电梯一样整体提升到上游 "can lift a large ship, like an elevator, up to the upper river." English just says "lift the ship," but Chinese uses 把 + object + verb + a result or destination (here 到上游), and the verb almost never stands bare at the end.
